name: Kanke
bio: Poet of the Hyakunin Isshu (no. 24); Porter’s note gives the dates as: d. 903.

poems.title: I bring no prayers on coloured silk
poems.author: Kanke
poems.collection: A Hundred Verses from Old Japan (Hyakunin Isshu), poem 24
poems.text:
I bring no prayers on coloured silk
To deck thy shrine to-day,
But take instead these maple leaves,
That grow at Tamuké;
Finer than silk are they.

poems.title: 24. 此の度は 幣もとりあへず 手向山 (Kono tabi wa nusa mo toriaezu Tamukeyama)
poems.author: Kanke
poems.collection: 小倉百人一首 (Ogura Hyakunin Isshu)
poems.note: Classical Japanese; from the 古今集
poems.text:
此の度は 幣もとりあへず 手向山
紅葉の錦 神のまにまに
